units.source_text: 匂亲王看出薰大将也在渴想浮舟，越发不放心起来。

en.t: Prince Niou realized that General Kaoru too was longing for Ukifune, and he grew still more uneasy.

units.source_text: 他就勉力筹划，有一天居然向宇治出发了。

en.t: He therefore strained every effort to arrange matters, and one day actually set out for Uji.

units.source_text: 京中的雪已渐消融，犹有残雪似在等伴。

en.t: In the capital the snow had already begun to melt away, though a little lingered as if waiting for company.
But the farther they went into the mountains, the deeper the accumulated snow became.

units.source_text: 那些羊肠坂道埋在雪中，全无人迹，与往常情况大异。

en.t: Those winding narrow slopes were buried in snow, with no trace of human passage at all, utterly unlike their usual state.

units.source_text: 随从人等又是恐慌，又是吃力，几乎想哭出来。

en.t: The attendants were both frightened and exhausted, and nearly felt like bursting into tears.

units.source_text: 带路人道定，身为大内记，又兼任式部少卿，

en.t: Michisada, who served as their guide, held the post of Great Secretary and also concurrently served as Junior Assistant Minister of Ceremonial,

units.source_text: 两者都是高贵的官职，但今天只得适应情况，

en.t: both of them distinguished offices, but today he had no choice except to adapt to the circumstances,

units.source_text: 撩起衣裾而徒步护驾，那姿态实甚可笑。

en.t: lifting the hem of his robes and walking on foot in attendance, a sight that was truly quite comical.
